text_block_list.text:
Judging by the voice, it's over on this 
side... behind the statue, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't know who you are, but you're a 
thousand years too early to try pulling 
pranks on Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Give it up and come out already~~!
